tools.name: search_prices
tools.description: Search what Medicare paid hospitals. q is free text: an everyday name of a hospital stay or outpatient procedure ("knee replacement", "pneumonia", "pacemaker"), a hospital name or a city. code is a DRG or APC code ("470", "APC 5491"). tools.name: compare_procedure
tools.description: For one DRG or APC code, optionally in one state: number of hospitals, lowest, median, highest, quartiles and the hospitals themselves (lowest first).

tools.name: hospital_profile
tools.description: One hospital by its CMS Certification Number (CCN): type, ownership, CMS overall star rating and its payment figures with the state median for comparison.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The DRG (hospital stay) and APC (outpatient) groups in the dataset with the national median payment and number of hospitals. Filter with q or kind.

tools.name: dataset_stats
tools.description: Live counts: payment figures, hospitals, service groups, states covered, data year, sources.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The official sources the dataset is built from, with record counts and reuse terms.

tools.name: atlas_code_change
tools.description: For one HCPCS code (and optional modifier): the Medicare physician fee schedule amounts for 2026 and 2027 — non-facility and facility, at the standard (non-QP) and qualifying-APM (QP) conversion factors — and the change. With a locality key (for example "TX-31"), that locality’s adjusted amounts are

tools.name: atlas_movers
tools.description: The codes whose Medicare fee schedule amounts change most from 2026 to 2027 (non-facility, non-QP, national), ranked by percent or by dollars, up or down.

tools.name: atlas_localities
tools.description: Every Medicare locality with its 2026 and 2027 geographic practice cost indices (work, practice expense, malpractice) from the CMS files.

tools.name: atlas_all_changes
tools.description: Every code’s 2026 and 2027 fee schedule amounts and the change, paged with limit and offset. Requires an Atlas API license on the account (or the owner): the free tier and other plans do not include the bulk table — single codes, the movers and locality figures stay public.

tools.name: atlas_stats
tools.description: The Atlas dataset: data version, the 2026 and 2027 conversion factors (read from the CMS files), payable/new/removed code counts, locality count, method and sources.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_prices" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: q, code, state, city, kind, limit
